text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Lip P...
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, insane...
Pokke-san's running just keeps getting
nastier...
She was overwhelming back when she was boss,
but she's still—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Alright. I got this...!

Tomorrow is finally the Debut Selection.
The field is packed with strong
contenders...
Some are even favored above Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's awesome.
First,
I'll smash the rival right in front of me—
and win!
choice_data_list: It's the beginning of the legend o...
It's the beginning of your legend ...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Pfft, that's so corny! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I love it,
even if it sounds cheesy as hell.
Let's show 'em,
then—my legend as the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Under overcast skies,
today's Debut Selection is underway.
Among this stacked field,
the favorite is Number 5.
A rising star boasting a formidable late
surge!

As expected,
Jungle Pocket hasn't drawn much attention.
However... she will win this race,
without a doubt.
choice_data_list: (Once she does, I'll scout her off...

text_block_list.text:
I'll ask her to aim for the "strongest"
together.
I'm sure she'll nod with conviction.
Imagining her expression—first,
I watch the race unfold.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
First race—
I'm gonna blow everyone out of the water.

I'd appreciate it if you didn't look down
on me with that "first race" talk.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—! Number 5... Oh, so you're the favorite.
Hear you're pretty tough,
Tsuzuki Reigning.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you.
Even if everyone else overlooks you,
I know you're strong. But...
I won't back down.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hah, bring it on.
Makes crushing you all the sweeter.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: 1,800 meters on turf—and they're off!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A clean break for Jungle Pocket,
as she smoothly settles into a prime
position!

Jungle Pocket controls her pace steadily.
She holds a great spot as the race
progresses—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
400 meters remaining,
they're lined up shoulder-to-shoulder!
Jungle Pocket makes her move!
And sweeping in from the outside,
Tsuzuki Reigning closes in with a furious
late surge!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hah, that's what I'm talkin' about!
But... here's where it really begins!!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
What—?! She's accelerating even more...!
Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Let's go, let's go, let's GOOOO!
I'M THE STRONGESTTTTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket breaks away!
She breaks away!
Jungle Pocket crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —HELL YEAH!!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, she's far beyond what I expected,
Jungle Pocket...
Next time, though... I will win...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Jungle Pocket,
I never thought she'd be that good.
Explosive power paired with calm race
management... Truly impressive...

After her sensational performance,
trainers are turning their eyes toward Jungle
Pocket.
Before anyone beats me to it, I need to—

Just as I resolved to scout her,
she sprints right off the track.
Either way, I have to chase after her...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Hold up, Tachyon!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What is it,
Pocket-kun? I happen to be quite busy,
so make it brief. Or perhaps...
are you offering your cooperation?
I happen to have an experiment in need of
a subject—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to disappoint, but hell no.
...I'm here to declare war,
Agnes Tachyon. Classmate to classmate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Classmates... hm. By the way,
have you signed a contract with a Trainer
yet?
choice_data_list: We haven't signed it just yet!

text_block_list.text:
I raise my voice and step in between them.
Now is my chance to coolly introduce myself
as Jungle Pocket's Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heh, perfect timing!

She throws an arm firmly around my
shoulder,
pulling me right beside her to face Agnes
Tachyon as a united front.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The two of us are gonna crush you!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna win and win and keep on winning
in the Twinkle Series,
and then blow right past you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You better polish that "natural-born speed"
of yours while you can.
Don't you dare lose before you get a chance
to face me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Well,
do give it your best shot.
And be sure to provide me with fascinating
data. I shall look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So, with that settled... Countin' on ya,
partner!

My grand plan to scout her with a cool
entrance completely crumbled...
Yet, seeing the carefree trust she placed
in me made me undeniably happy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's with the weak response, huh?
At times like this,
you gotta rev that engine and yell,
right?!

She's right.
Now that Jungle Pocket has acknowledged me
as her partner,
I need to fire myself up too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! That's what I'm talkin' about,
partner!
